4ae924e6.text:
Your first stop should be Ironforge which can be reached via the technological marvel known as the Deeprun Tram.

You can find the entrance to the tram in the Dwarven District here in Stormwind, just to the southwest of the keep. The tram will transport you safely to the heart of Ironforge City.

Once you arrive, explore the city and locate High Tinker Mekkatorque and King Magni Bronzebeard in Tinker Town and the Great Forge, respectively. Introduce yourself as an agent of the $R and they will show you their hospitality.
4ae924e6.title: Advisor Emerson's Instructions

5c8c56b7.text:
After you've become acquainted with the other leaders of the alliance, Lord Fordragon has requested that you report back to him here in the keep.

I wish you good fortune in your journeys, $R.
5c8c56b7.title: Advisor Emerson's Instructions

79eb1dce.text:
The city of Darnassus can be found across the sea, off the coast of northern Kalimdor. The city itself rests at the top of the great tree, Teldrassil.

The safest route for you currently is via the harbor on the west side of Stormwind. Take the ship departing from the southernmost dock to the port of Auberdine.

Upon arriving, proceed to the north side of the Auberdine docks and take the ship there to Ru'theran Village. This village contains a magical transporter that will take you into the city itself.

Explore Darnassus and seek out Tyrande Whisperwind, the High Priestess of Elune.
79eb1dce.title: Advisor Emerson's Instructions

ed4434f9.text:
Greetings,

As a guest of the Alliance, you have been given leave to travel freely throughout Alliance lands. 

This document will serve as a guide to help you reach the other member cities of our alliance.
ed4434f9.title: Advisor Emerson's Instructions

11026|766a64ec.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
11026|766a64ec.text: Ah, what a beautiful day to blow something up!

1300|e17121fb.name: Lawrence Schneider
1300|e17121fb.text: Hmm... the things you need to learn are a little above my head. Have a talk with Sellandus over at Larson's Clothiers just up the path to the right. He taught me everything I know!

1325|e69bef2b.name: Jasper Fel
1325|e69bef2b.text: Speak quietly and with great care, the wrong word in these parts could get your throat cut. Now, what is it you need from me?

2327|2957a3a0.name: Shaina Fuller
2327|2957a3a0.text: Oh, a fellow Physician. I would be glad to teach you anything that would aid your journeys.

234|eba492ed.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
234|eba492ed.text: A foul corruption has crept into Westfall.  While I was upholding my duty on the battlefields of Lordaeron these honest farms were overrun and made into hide-outs for thugs and murderers. The People's Militia needs your help.

253092|e0247c5d.name: Alba Fairmoon
253092|e0247c5d.text:
I am told the farms of Westfall once supplied a bounty of crops for Stormwind. But now, the soil is barren and most of the farmers have fled.

On behalf of Darnassus I would like to offer my aid in replenishing this land. Will you assist me?

523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

5493|e332eb6d.name: Arnold Leland
5493|e332eb6d.text: Ah, a fellow Fisherman. Are you perhaps in need of a little training? Maybe I can show you a thing or two?

5494|ed056522.name: Catherine Leland
5494|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

5497|9c6df40b.name: Jennea Cannon
5497|9c6df40b.text: Greetings $c.  Shall I provide you with further insight into the world of magic?

656|eb6991e6.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
656|eb6991e6.text:
There were thieves everywhere! 

It was horrible.  The cave came down on us.  I think the mining company is all dead, including my brother, the Foreman.

8931|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Heather
8931|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

135-progress.name: Master Mathias Shaw
135-progress.text: What business do you have with me?  I am a very busy man. . .
135-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

141-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
141-progress.text: Did Master Shaw shed any light on things?
141-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

142-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
142-progress.text: $N, were you able to gather any information?  Did you locate the messenger?
142-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

166-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
166-progress.text: How goes the hunt for Edwin VanCleef?
166-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

167-progress.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
167-progress.text: Did you find any sign of my brother?  Is there any hope after all this time?
167-progress.title: Oh Brother...

168-progress.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
168-progress.text: Were you able to retrieve any of my old co-worker's Miners' Union Cards?
168-progress.title: Collecting Memories

2040-progress.name: Shoni the Shilent
2040-progress.text: Have you found the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket, $N?
2040-progress.title: Underground Assault

334-accept.name: Rema Schneider
334-accept.text:
My son Thurman is an apprentice at the Larson Clothiers, in the $C's Quarter.  He was in a hurry today and forgot his shears and needles.  I know a great $C like you must have important tasks at hand, but without his tools Thurman can't do his apprentice work!

Please, $N.  Can you take my son's sewing kit to him?  Larson Clothiers is one of two clothing shops in the $C's Quarter - it's the one deeper in, near the $C's Tower.
334-accept.title: Package for Thurman
